Gather all following ingredients and follow the directions to prepare this tasty meal.

Ingredients:
purple potato
  red onion
  carrot
  block of cheese
  red apple

Directions:
slice the purple potato
  roast the purple potato
  dice the red onion
  fry the red onion
  slice the carrot
  roast the carrot
  chop the block of cheese
  roast the block of cheese
  dice the red apple
  fry the red apple
  prepare meal
